creative_genome.body: A civic-grid campaign system that makes local orientation and verified comparison the lead mechanism.
creative_genome.alt: Abstract D.C. signal grid with a central verified marker
creative_genome.targetAudience: D.C. adults 21+ who know their neighborhood but not the verified options nearby
creative_genome.customerProblem: Local choice is fragmented and difficult to orient.
creative_genome.offer: A verified comparison path organized around D.C. location.
creative_genome.visualConcept: An original civic signal grid and abstract verified marker.
creative_genome.localDcCue: Civic grid plus a central star marker evokes district orientation without copying a map or seal.
creative_genome.localDcRelevance: Block and district orientation without copying a map or landmark.
creative_genome.imageSourcePlan: Rights-cleared deterministic vector fixture; no competitor or merchant asset.
creative_genome.desktopComposition: Wide civic grid beside editorial copy.
creative_genome.mobileComposition: Vertical signal marker followed by the same editorial hierarchy.
creative_genome.headline: Find the signal on your side of D.C.
creative_genome.negativePrompt: No skyline, map screenshot, product pile, fake storefront, generated text, or competitor expression.
authenticityRisks: Could read as a government seal if rendered too literally.
unsupportedClaimRisks: Do not imply official D.C. endorsement.
creative_genome.testablePrediction: Owner-approved variant may increase qualified comparison starts versus the house fallback; not yet tested.
